formation.context_sufficient.v2.instructions: Do the supplied authorized observation and retrieved memories contain enough relevant context to make a safe memory decision?

formation.future_utility.v2.instructions: Rate the likely future usefulness of retaining the proposed state.

formation.is_durable.v2.instructions: Does the authorized observation express information likely to remain useful in future interactions?

formation.memory_class.v2.instructions: Classify the observation's supported memory type.

options.description: Standing user choice or desired assistant behavior.
Stable fact likely useful in future interactions.
Future obligation or promise with continuing relevance.
Past event worth retaining as an episode.
Potentially durable information requiring stricter review.
Content that should not become memory.

formation.operation.v2.instructions: Select the one memory-state operation supported by the authorized evidence.

options.description: Create distinct durable memory not represented by current state.
Add compatible detail to one active memory.
Replace one active memory that is no longer current.
The same meaning is already represented by one active memory.
Do not create persistent memory from this observation.
Honor an explicit authorized request to retire one memory.

formation.target.v2.instructions: Select the active memory targeted by the proposed operation.
